n1MinimapTheGate: 1MinimapThe gate to take is the gold square with a pulsing ring; a dotted line joins it to your ship.
n2InSpaceA: 2In spaceA gold arrow at the screen edge points to the gate when it is off screen; on screen the gate is marked NEXT JUMP.
n3JumpClickFly: 3JumpClick Fly to gate below the minimap (or fly there yourself) and press J. The route updates after every jump.
